review_comments:
mpp returns a `MPPGather` when `buildTableReader `

https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/blob/cf23666766d03ec9c2551465fbb92e0f9bba25a2/pkg/executor/builder.go#L3414-L3435

MPPGather will always call `ConstructTreeBasedDistExec` when `ConstructDAGReq`

https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/blob/cf23666766d03ec9c2551465fbb92e0f9bba25a2/pkg/executor/internal/builder/builder_utils.go#L46-L59

For `TableReaderExecutor`, only when `e.corColInFilter = true` will call `ConstructTreeBasedDistExec`

https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/blob/cf23666766d03ec9c2551465fbb92e0f9bba25a2/pkg/executor/table_reader.go#L142-L161
